payload.headline: SPY closes below its 200-day line; QQQ closes under its 1-month low

summary.thesis: Both indices are in downtrends. SPY closed at 715.87, below its 200-day average of 730.2. QQQ closed at 645.04, below its 1-month low of 647.05. Breadth is 17% and fear, as of Nov 18, is elevated. Taken together, the readings show broad selling, not a rotation within the market.
summary.decision: Stand aside for both long-term and swing buying. This is research, not advice.
summary.act_at: A QQQ close above 682.01, its 200-day average and the market gate, ends the tech downtrend. A SPY close back above 730.2 would put its long-term trend back up.

payload.happening: SPY fell 1.96% to 715.87. It is down 5.45% over five days and 6.29% over twenty days. Its prior close of 730.2 matched both its 200-day average and its 1-month low (Nov 18), and today's close went through both. QQQ fell 2.19% to 645.04. It is down 6.27% over five days and 8.44% over twenty days. That close is 0.3% below its 1-month low of 647.05 (Nov 5). Both indices set their 1-month highs on Oct 28 and their past-year highest closes on Oct 6: 779.09 for SPY and 759.66 for QQQ. No news has been stored since the last note. The latest stored VIX is from Nov 18 because the Nov 19 reading isn't stored yet.
payload.business: The three readings agree. Trend: SPY and QQQ are both below their 50- and 200-day averages, which the data labels a downtrend. Fear: the VIX closed at 24.56 on Nov 18, in the 'elevated' band (20–30). Breadth: only 17% of stocks are above their 50-day averages, so most stocks are falling along with the indices, not just a few large names. When the trend is down, fear is elevated and breadth is narrow, the market is under pressure across the board.

worth.text: No valuation is implied. The levels in this note are price-trend markers only.
worth.key_assumption: No valuation is implied. The levels are price-trend markers only.

bull: Fear eased slightly in the latest stored reading: the VIX went from 25.46 to 24.56 on Nov 18. It is still below the 'high' band, which starts at 30.
QQQ is only 0.3% below its 1-month low of 647.05. A close back above it would mean the recent low is holding.
Breadth is 17%, up from the 15% cited in the previous note.
bear: SPY closed below its 200-day average of 730.2, which puts the broad market's long-term trend down. That close also set a new 1-month low.
QQQ's close of 645.04 is below its 1-month low of 647.05, which means the tech decline is continuing. QQQ is 5.7% below its 200-day gate and 10.5% below its 50-day average.

levels.what: QQQ 200-day average and the market gate. A close above it ends the tech downtrend, which would support a selective stance.
QQQ 50-day average. A close above it would put tech's short-term trend back up and pass the pipeline's market check. That would be the cue to lean in more.
QQQ 1-month high (Oct 28). A close above it would mean the tech pullback is fully recovered.
QQQ 1-month low (Nov 5). QQQ closed 0.3% below it. A close back above it would mean the recent low is holding.
SPY 200-day average and 1-month low (Nov 18). SPY closed 2.0% below it. A close back above it would put the broad market's long-term trend back up.
SPY 50-day average. A close above it would put SPY's short-term trend back up.
SPY 1-month high (Oct 28). A close above it would mean SPY's pullback is fully recovered.

longterm.why: QQQ remains below its 200-day gate of 682.01. SPY has now closed below its 200-day average of 730.2. Breadth is 17% and fear is elevated. All three readings argue against new buying until QQQ closes above 682.01.

swing.why: QQQ closed at 645.04, 10.5% below its 50-day average of 713.0. Below that level, setups keep failing the pipeline's market check.

decision.timing: Two releases are due Nov 25 at 08:30. One is the second estimate of Q3 GDP and corporate profits. The other is October Personal Income and Outlays, which includes PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation measure. The fear reading here is from Nov 18 because the Nov 19 VIX isn't stored yet. The nearest levels to watch are QQQ 647.05 and SPY 730.2.

change_mind: The stance would move toward selective if QQQ closes above 682.01, its 200-day average and the market gate, which ends the tech downtrend. It would move further toward leaning in if QQQ closes above its 50-day average of 713.0.

The case for staying aside would weaken if SPY closes back above 730.2, which restores its long-term uptrend. It would strengthen if QQQ keeps closing below 647.05 while breadth stays near 17% and the VIX stays in the elevated band or moves into the 'high' band at 30 or above.
payload.what_changed: SPY went from closing on its 200-day line (730.2 on Nov 18) to closing below it at 715.87, and that close set a new 1-month low. QQQ fell from 659.51 to 645.04, which is below its Nov 5 low of 647.05. The moving gates shifted: QQQ's 200-day average went from 681.80 to 682.01 and its 50-day from 714.26 to 713.0. SPY's 200-day went from 730.02 to 730.2 and its 50-day from 762.28 to 761.48. Breadth went from 15% to 17%. The stored VIX went from 25.46 to 24.56 and is still elevated. The stance is unchanged: stand aside.
payload.label: Research, not advice.
